create_stable_audio_pipeline: create a StableAudioPipeline instance for text-to-audio generation with T5 encoder and DiT transformer
run_audio_generation: run text-to-audio generation with StableAudioPipeline using prompts, inference steps, and guidance scale
encode_prompt_embeddings: encode text prompts into hidden-state embeddings using T5 encoder and projection model
encode_duration_embeddings: encode audio start and end durations in seconds into hidden-state embeddings via projection model
prepare_latents_with_audio: prepare diffusion latents from random noise or encode initial audio waveforms for inpainting
